tokens.usage: Primary text and all outlines. Midnight in light. 12:1 or better on surface-page and surface-card.

tokens.name: ink-muted

tokens.name: outline
tokens.usage: The 3px border on every clickable or shareable element, and the hard shadow edge.

tokens.name: brand-launch
tokens.usage: Launch yellow. Hero fills, the badge, Building status. Always carries ink text (11.9:1). Same in both themes.

tokens.name: brand-flamingo
tokens.usage: Flamingo pink. Highlights, the second wordmark line, card headers. Carries ink text (5.6:1), never white.

tokens.name: brand-orbit
tokens.usage: Orbit blue. Primary buttons and active controls. Carries white text (4.9:1).

tokens.name: on-orbit
tokens.usage: Text on brand-orbit and on dark navy fills.

tokens.name: link

tokens.name: focus-ring

tokens.name: status-shipped
